recipe: REFINED: leak resonance notched (856/890/920 Hz), gurgle peak +2 dB Q1.5, loop rotated 4.840 s so the wrap sits at median level. 6.0 s loop. 5 chunks (1.5 s) of the pressure-cooker venting hiss (0805 @ 24.3/37.9/51.2/66.8/44.6 s) + air leak (1486, -3 dB), each RMS-matched, joined with 0.3 s equal-power crossfades and tail->head crossfade. Cyclic EQ: HP 120 Hz (4-pole) + 2x HP 40 Hz, LP 4-pole morphing 1600->2500 Hz (equal-power blend of two decorrelated chains driven by a 2/7/11-cycle LFO), low shelf +8 dB @700 Hz, presence +4 dB @1000 Hz, high shelf -5 dB @4.5 kHz. Turbulence: AM depth 0.16 from 1/3/5/8/13-cycles-per-loop sines + 9 Hz smoothed noise. Gurgle: 260-780 Hz band of the same hiss gated by an 8 Hz smoothed random envelope (above threshold), tanh soft-limited, at 0.45x hiss RMS. No whistle. Peak -6 dBFS.
used_for: Junction pressure-line loop, gauge low (game crossfades/levels -28..-8 dB).

recipe: REFINED: leak resonance notched, loop rotated so the wrap sits at median level (the old wrap fell in the deepest billow trough). 8.0 s loop (not a multiple of the 6 s pressure loop, so the two never lock). 5 chunks of cooker venting hiss (0805) + air leak (1486, -7 dB), RMS-matched, 0.45 s equal-power crossfades, tail->head crossfade. used_for: Coolant cloud (soft, rolling steam bed; play at low level, fade in/out).
